messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGE: High rate of 504/timeout errors for customer 'Galileo' on their Private VPC deployment. Source: NLB -> backend socket timeouts. Impact: API clients seeing intermittent failures, ~30% of requests failing since 11:12 UTC. Initiating incident channel.
oncall-sre: I'm on it. Acknowledging page and grabbing pager history.
netops-julia: I see a spike in failed TCP handshakes from the NLB to the target group at 11:12. Health checks still passing but backend app logs show 'read timeout' and 'connection reset by peer'.
customer-success-lina: Galileo reporting increased 5xx rate in their dashboard and some users seeing timeouts. They've asked for ETA and mitigation.
eng-platform-omar: Can we confirm whether this is ALB or NLB? The customer's private stack uses NLB in front of host-facing proxies.
netops-julia: NLB network target group. Targets are host-level proxies in the tenant VPC. NLB connection metrics: TargetResponseTime spiked and TargetConnectionErrorCount increased.
oncall-sre: Running quick checks: `curl -v --resolve api.galileo.internal:443:10.2.5.12 https://api.galileo.internal/healthz` returns TLS handshake then hangs for ~30s -> timeout.
eng-platform-omar: Can we check backend keepalive and max connections? If proxies are dropping idle connections, NLB may hit exhausted sockets.
netops-julia: Good point. I'm SSHing to one of the proxy hosts to check `ss -tanp` and kernel conntrack.
netops-julia: Found many TIME_WAIT sockets and high conntrack count nearing 65536. `sudo sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count` -> 64210.
oncall-sre: That explains intermittent resets. Are recent deploys touching proxy config?
eng-platform-omar: No recent platform deploys for that tenant since yesterday. But we did push a kernel backport across nodes last week — could be related.
customer-success-lina: Galileo wants a short-term workaround. Can we shift traffic to a warm standby or increase NLB connection draining?
oncall-sre: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily increase conntrack max and timeout on tenant hosts; 2) Enable NLB cross-zone balancing to spread connections; 3) If conntrack continues to climb, perform a controlled restart of proxy process on a single host and drain traffic. Who can execute config change?
netops-julia: I can bump conntrack limits now (sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000) and reduce timeouts. Applying to one host to test then roll.
eng-platform-omar: I'll prepare a weighted failover to the customer's dedicated spare pool (we have a standby pool in the same region). Can we do a weighted shift 80/20 to standby to reduce pressure?
oncall-sre: Sounds good. Make sure DNS TTLs are respected — this is a private VPC, so we control route table weights via our routing plane. Keep me updated.
eng-platform-omar: Executing traffic shift now: `route-control shift --customer galileo --from active --to standby --weight 20`
eng-platform-omar: Shift applied. Observing NLB target metrics — connection error rate down 40% on primary.
netops-julia: Conntrack bump applied on three hosts in rotation. nf_conntrack_count dropped to ~18k after cleanup.
oncall-sre: Can you confirm backend health and client success rate?
eng-platform-omar: Galileo reports 95% reduction in timeouts on their end, error rate back to baseline for most routes. Monitoring for 15 more minutes before full rollover back.
customer-success-lina: I told Galileo we performed a partial failover and kernel parameter tuning. They want a follow-up RCA and whether any credits are warranted.
product-ryan: Log this as a P1 for RCA. We should check kernel backport interactions and conntrack defaults for private host pools.
oncall-sre: Agreed. Immediate mitigations succeeded. Next steps: 1) Continue monitoring for 30m; 2) Schedule RCA with netops + platform + customer; 3) Draft customer-facing incident summary.
eng-platform-omar: I'll own the customer summary draft. netops-julia please collate kernel/conntrack metrics.
netops-julia: Will do. I've already captured `sysctl` outputs and `ss` snapshots.
customer-success-lina: Please mark incident as 'ongoing-but-stable' and update Galileo that we're pausing further disruptive actions.
oncall-sre: Marked. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=ongoing-stable, severity=P1, assignees=[oncall-sre, netops-julia, eng-platform-omar], pager_history_link=<https://pager.example/incident/6612345678>
product-ryan: Postmortem owners assigned after RCA. Let's not forget to review runbook to include conntrack thresholds and standby pool automations.
eng-platform-omar: Noted. Closing live mitigation chat in 30m if metrics stay green.
customer-success-lina: Galileo acknowledged and said they appreciate the quick action.
netops-julia: Final check: conntrack now 12k, no new errors in NLB metrics for 10m.
oncall-sre: If nothing spike, we'll close at last_message_ts. Followups scheduled.
